''See also: [[Jai Daishou Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Jai]] Daishou was the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] and [[Underlord]] of the [[Jai clan]]. A highly respected figure throughout [[The Empire|the Empire]], he spent much of his life cultivating a reputation for honor. He was a practitioner of the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]], utilizing specialized spear arts such as the Fall of Seven Stars. His physical appearance was characterized by white robes with blue accents and long, metallic hair resulting from his [[Goldsign]]. As an [[Underlord]], he possessed significant power and [[Authority|authority]], though his later years were marked by physical decline, including a curved back and failing strength. Despite his approaching death, he remained a formidable combatant capable of testing others with his skills. He was deeply invested in the future of his clan, offering to mentor potential successors and swearing to protect [[Jai Long]] and [[Jai Chen]] provided they remained loyal. His life ended following a period of intense emotional distress, resulting in a fatal heart attack.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Jai]] Daishou has hair composed of white metal strands. During certain moments, his face turned red and his lips were speckled with blood.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|He holds propriety as his highest virtue. As the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] of the [[Jai clan]] and the seventh [[Underlord]] of the [[Blackflame Empire]], he has conducted personal trials for [[Jai Long]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Jai]] Daishou's actions influenced the circumstances surrounding [[Jai Long]]. He also conducted personal trials for [[Jai Long]] and released unstable [[madra]] that affected [[Jai Chen]]'s core. Additionally, [[Lindon]] suggested that [[Eithan]] possessed the ability to have ended [[Jai]] Daishou's life instantly, and [[Renfei]] had intentions regarding [[Jai]] Daishou's testimony.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|He possesses the [[Goldsign]] of the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]] and utilizes the [[Ancestor's Spear]]. His repertoire includes the [[Star Lance]], Fall of Seven Stars, and [[Flowing Starlight]] techniques, as well as [[Enforcer]], [[Forger]], and [[Striker]] skills.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|Patriarch of the Jai}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|[[Jai]] Daishou considers propriety to be the highest virtue.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c2">''Blackflame'', chapter 2</ref> As a [[Truegold]] elder, he serves as the [[Jai Patriarch|Patriarch]] of the [[Jai clan]], which is the third-ranked of the three great clans.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c8">''Blackflame'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c19">''Blackflame'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c20">''Blackflame'', chapter 20</ref> He is the seventh [[Underlord]] of the [[Blackflame Empire]] and has been involved in a conflict between [[Underlord|Underlords]].<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c17">''Blackflame'', chapter 17</ref> In combat, he utilizes the [[Ancestor's Spear]] alongside several techniques, including [[Star Lance]], Fall of Seven Stars, [[Flowing Starlight]], and both [[Enforcer]] and [[Forger]] methods.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c20" /> [[Renfei]] had intentions to obtain testimony from him.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c22">''Blackflame'', chapter 22</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The Archstone struggle}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|[[Jai]] Daishou is a dying [[Jai Underlord]] characterized by hair made of white metal strands and a permanently damaged spirit.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c1">''Skysworn'', chapter 1</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6">''Skysworn'', chapter 6</ref> Possessing the [[Goldsign]] of the [[Path of the Stellar Spear]], he utilized a [[Striker technique]] capable of blasting through stone.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c4">''Skysworn'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6" /> His face turned red and his lips became speckled with blood as he drew power from the [[Archstone]], an action that eventually eroded his soul's foundation.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c5">''Skysworn'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6" /> His death caused an [[Underlord's Remnant]] to manifest and altered the circumstances surrounding [[Jai Long]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c6" /><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7">''Skysworn'', chapter 7</ref> While [[Lindon]] believed [[Eithan]] could have ended him instantly, [[Jai]] Daishou managed to open a [[labyrinth entrance]] within his territory.<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c7" /> He released a rush of unstable [[madra]] that caused [[Jai Chen]]'s core to swell and later retrieved the [[Archstone]] from a [[western labyrinth]].<ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c9">''Skysworn'', chapter 9</ref><ref name="cradle-04-skysworn-c11">''Skysworn'', chapter 11</ref>}}
